name: Yanda Spearmasters

abilities.name: Sea Sickness
abilities.text: As these men are inexperienced sailors. Caught up in sea combat, they suffer various penalties.

abilities.name: Rapid Advance
abilities.text: Improved unit movement speed over an extended period.

abilities.name: Steady
abilities.text: Improves the unit's ability to defend at the cost of their mobility.

attributes.name: Expert Charge Defence
attributes.text: This unit’s melee attack and damage are increased against charging enemies.

attributes.name: Hide (forest)
attributes.text: This unit can hide in forests until enemy units get too close.

short: Yanda’s spears strike fear into men’s mortal hearts.
history: Yanda was the name given to the White Huns by the Chinese scholars who came into contact with them. In the very early days, many did not differentiate between the Hephthalites and the more famous Huns but, as time went by and the White Huns’ empire grew in power and sophistication, the great powers became increasingly aware of both their differentiations and of the danger they presented. According to the Chinese, the eastern elements of the White Hun hordes eventually took up Buddhist practices and beliefs – albeit tempered with the influence of western religions (such as Zoroastrianism) picked up during their conquests
strengths: Very low damage and armour penetration
